beats.say: 16 seasons: Bleach officially ended its long journey on Saturday 26 October.
The final season, Thousand-Year Blood War, marks the official conclusion for Studio Pierrot's hit series.
Interestingly, while you know the name for the household cleaner that removes colour, this production does the opposite.
According to Polygon, the new episodes use dark-fantasy film techniques, adding dense shadows and atmosphere rather than taking anything away.
It is a fitting end to a story that ran for 16 seasons.
